PR #623 is fully green on every real CI check (Lint, Type Check, Build, Unit Tests, E2E, security/guardrail checks, etc.) and `MERGEABLE`. The only outstanding gate is `audit-check`, which requires a structured `AUDIT: PASS/FAIL` comment from an agent other than the implementer (per `AUTH-03`, "no self-certification" — this session did the implementing work across invocations 1–2). I deliberately did not self-post that audit comment, consistent with how other in-flight PRs in this same repo are handled. No further repo-side work remains; I recorded this confirmed state in `PROGRESS.md` and pushed it. Next step is for an external auditor to review and post the verdict on PR #623.
